title: T04c — Placement report and recommendation
privacy: Repository-owned neutral fixtures; do not send private inputs to another inference host or enable services/devices without existing authorization.
acceptance: Compare Mac-only baseline, Mac coder plus mini PC specialist/auditor, and mini PC tools/tests with Mac inference under equivalent tasks and budgets
Bind exact model/runtime/hardware, memory and concurrent load; measure task outcomes, queue, network, latency and resource cost
Unavailable Mac, disconnected auditor, cancellation and uncertain outcomes preserve privacy, leases and permission gates
Only selected authorized enrolled targets run live cases; fixture evidence cannot establish real-device suitability
Use one normal home mini PC baseline, not separate office/home/day/night conditions; vary inference/tools-test contention only when intended concurrent NERV work justifies it
Use F-006-T05 Mac operating-condition evidence when relevant; Mac sleep/unavailability remains a dependency/recovery check
validation: Validate NERV pack/adapter across the Gauntlet evidence boundary with neutral fixtures
Run applicable scoped checks and required CI; live acceptance is separately recorded
escalation: Stop on unclear ownership, missing prerequisites, privacy changes or uncertain external effects
Escalate repeated tool failures or inadequate context; no automatic cloud fallback

effort.basis: Re-estimated 2026-11-13 at 0.25x from node tools/work-items.mjs calibrate (median 0.25x over 16 closed steps since 2026-11-12).
